'''Michael Girard Tatooine Beats''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Girard]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-2789">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/2789 Tatooine Beats], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 31 January 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/2789/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/2789/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018210418/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/2789/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Girard]]
* '''Published:''' 31 January 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Tatooine Beats''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor TB Girard DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is used to counter-attack Profit and beats on tatooine

== Original post ==

'''Tatooine Beats'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Dvader" Girard
* '''Published:''' January 31, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is used to counter-attack Profit and beats on tatooine

=== Strategy ===

This deck will give Profit a run for their money.	Profit will have a hard time with activation if they get their sites converted first turn.
